sourceText: User asked: continue the second group of the Unattended Develop Mode no-false-DONE 10x15 milestone baseline after G01.
normalizedOutcome: Implement only G02 as an independent missing-row negative-control baseline: 15 required rows, 14 generated closed rows, exactly one missing required row, no full roadmap completion claim, and documentation that G01-G02 are implemented while G03-G10 remain future.
acceptanceClaim: G02 is DONE only if the standalone G02 smoke passes and the baseline document says G02 is implemented without claiming the full 10x15 baseline is complete.
